overview: One is energy in transit. The other is a measure of how 'hot' something currently is.
genZNote: Temperature is a status update. Heat is the energy actually being sent.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Energy transferred between systems due to a temperature difference.
aspects.valueB: Measure of the average kinetic energy of a substance's particles.

aspects.label: State or Transfer?
aspects.valueA: A form of energy in transit — exists only while flowing.
aspects.valueB: A state property describing a system's current condition.

aspects.label: Depends on Amount of Substance?
aspects.valueA: Yes — more substance needs more heat for the same temperature change.
aspects.valueB: No — temperature doesn't depend on how much substance is present.
